version "4.14"
// TEST ONLY (never ships). Drives both controllers per tic through scripted motions (the rig's
// qzt_rhand / qzt_lhand, stage metres / degrees: x right, y up, z back; pitch up, yaw, roll) and asks
// RSQ_Gestures by name every tic, through RSQG_Service, with no compile dependency. Logs every change.
//   (keyframes generated by tools/genprobe.py from AIM terms: pointing pitch/yaw and the wrist twist)
//   gpr_motion 1 right hand: aim, raise, twist, hold, untwist, twist, lower
//              2 the same, left hand (mirror image)
//              3 false positives: aim sweeps, aim down the sights, chest reload with the gun tilted,
//                a fast roll flick at the face, a fast swing through the pose, then a canted aim
//              4 one way only test: right +70 then -70, left mirror +70 then mirror -70
//              6 thrust, pull, both down, both apart, both palms out, then a two-handed rifle hold
//   gpr_ask 0: never ask (cost test)
class GPR_Probe : EventHandler
{

	static String Pose(int m, int hand, int t)
	{
		int n = GPR_Probe.K.Size() / 9;
		int prev = -1;
		for (int r = 0; r < n; r++)
		{
			if (GPR_Probe.K[r * 9] != m || GPR_Probe.K[r * 9 + 1] != hand) continue;
			if (GPR_Probe.K[r * 9 + 2] > t && prev >= 0)
			{
				double a = GPR_Probe.K[prev * 9 + 2], b = GPR_Probe.K[r * 9 + 2];
				double u = (t - a) / (b - a);
				double v[6];
				for (int c = 0; c < 6; c++) v[c] = GPR_Probe.K[prev * 9 + 3 + c] + (GPR_Probe.K[r * 9 + 3 + c] - GPR_Probe.K[prev * 9 + 3 + c]) * u;
				return Turned(v[0], v[1], v[2], v[3], v[4], v[5]);
			}
			prev = r;
		}
		if (prev < 0) return "";
		return Turned(GPR_Probe.K[prev*9+3], GPR_Probe.K[prev*9+4], GPR_Probe.K[prev*9+5], GPR_Probe.K[prev*9+6], GPR_Probe.K[prev*9+7], GPR_Probe.K[prev*9+8]);
	}

	// the whole pose turned about the vertical by gpr_yaw (the player standing turned in the room:
	// pair with QZ_HMD "0 1.6 0 0 <gpr_yaw> 0")
	static String Turned(double x, double y, double z, double p, double yw, double r)
	{
		double a = CVar.FindCVar("gpr_yaw").GetFloat();
		double c = cos(a), sn = sin(a);
		return String.Format("%.3f %.3f %.3f %.2f %.2f %.2f", x * c + z * sn, y, -x * sn + z * c, p, yw + a, r);
	}

	override void NetworkProcess(ConsoleEvent e)
	{
		let pmo = players[e.Player].mo; if (!pmo) return;
		if (e.Name == "gpr_go") { t0 = level.maptime; Console.Printf("T_GO t%d motion %d", level.maptime, CVar.FindCVar("gpr_motion").GetInt()); }
		else if (e.Name == "gpr_turn") { pmo.angle = e.Args[0]; Console.Printf("T_TURN t%d angle %.0f", level.maptime, pmo.angle); }
		else if (e.Name ~== "rsqg_thrust" || e.Name ~== "rsqg_pull" || e.Name ~== "rsqg_pair")
			Console.Printf("T_EV t%d %s %d %d", level.maptime, e.Name, e.Args[0], e.Args[1]);
	}

	ui int frames;
	override void RenderOverlay(RenderEvent e) { frames++; if (frames % 35 == 0) Console.Printf("T_F %d g%d", frames, gametic); }

	override void WorldTick()
	{
		let pmo = players[consoleplayer].mo; if (!pmo) return;
		int m = CVar.FindCVar("gpr_motion").GetInt();
		int t = t0 > 0 ? level.maptime - t0 : 0;   // before go: hold the first pose (no jump at the start)
		String r = Pose(m, 0, t), l = Pose(m, 1, t);
		if (r != "") CVar.FindCVar("qzt_rhand").SetString(r);
		if (l != "") CVar.FindCVar("qzt_lhand").SetString(l);
		if (t0 <= 0 || !CVar.FindCVar("gpr_ask").GetInt()) return;

		let it = ServiceIterator.Find("RSQG_Service");
		Service s = it.Next();
		if (!s) { if (t == 1) Console.Printf("T_NOSERVICE"); return; }
		int i0 = s.GetInt("inspect", "", 0), i1 = s.GetInt("inspect", "", 1);
		if (i0 != last0 || i1 != last1)
			Console.Printf("T_I t%d g%d main %d off %d  (pose met %d / %d tics)  mainleft %d", t, gametic, i0, i1, s.GetInt("inspect.tics", "", 0), s.GetInt("inspect.tics", "", 1), s.GetInt("mainleft"));
		last0 = i0; last1 = i1;
		if (t % 5 == 0)
		{
			String o = String.Format("T_H t%d ang %.0f", t, pmo.angle);
			for (int h = 0; h < 2; h++)
				o.AppendFormat("  %s fwd %.2f left %.2f up %.2f roll %.0f pit %.0f", h == 0 ? "main" : "off",
					s.GetDouble("hand.x", "", h), s.GetDouble("hand.y", "", h), s.GetDouble("hand.z", "", h), s.GetDouble("hand.roll", "", h), s.GetDouble("hand.pitch", "", h));
			Console.Printf("%s  [%s | %s]", o, r, l);
		}
	}
}
